title: Coven automation authority binding (coven.automations.authority.v1)
description: The exact identity and authority a run is authorized under. Dispatch is fail-closed: a run never launches without a binding that verifies at dispatch time, not only at decision time.

familiarRevision.description: Exact familiar contract revision the run binds to; a revoked or stale revision fails dispatch.

requiredCapabilities.description: Capability set the runtime must hold at dispatch; a downgrade between decision and dispatch refuses the run.

nonce.description: Single-use approval nonce; replay is refused and consumption is recorded once.
